suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Heel replacement
suggested_services.example: The main story: new heels for a pair of dress shoes, $35 from the shop's board. Nothing is taken: a YES books the drop-off. Gianni texts READY, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

suggested_services.name: Shoe restoration
suggested_services.example: A pair of boots that need restoring, priced at the counter after a look. Nothing is taken. Gianni's written price is OK'd before any work, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

suggested_services.name: Boot resole
suggested_services.example: A stitched boot resole, $140. A $40 deposit orders the soles, and the $100 rest is paid at the counter at pick-up.

suggested_services.name: Shoe repair at home
suggested_services.example: The main story: a home visit for a pair of boots and a pair of dress shoes. Only the $15 pickup fee is promised, with a card saved for it. Hector prices each item at the visit. The shoes come back Tue Oct 27, and Rosie texts the bill.

suggested_services.name: Heel replacement

before_times: What needs fixing: heels, soles, a zipper, a strap, stretching, or other
The kind of shoe or boot and what it is made of
The date they are needed by

safety_and_stop_words.stop_action: no danger words of its own: the generic screen (danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency, crisis words) is always on

staff.who_oks: the owner OKs restoration prices over $200, stitched resoles and any fee
staff.stand_in: heels, soles and zippers: any cobbler; stitched resoles and restoration: only the master cobbler

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian books for a child's shoes
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts about a child's shoes go to the parent who booked

visit.check_in: the check-in code at the counter; a walk-in drop-off is checked in at the counter at once; at a home visit, the code at the door
visit.done: the code at pick-up checks the visit in; at a home visit, DONE after the try-on at the return
visit.changes_at_visit: a new problem found while the shoes are in is texted with its price first; nothing extra without a yes; no answer in 2 days: left as it is
